thread:
natalie: Quick async check — rolling the new routing slice (5% canary) this morning. Please post what you did / blockers / plan for next hour. Trying to keep it tight so we can decide ramp.
jeff: Done initial smoke — infra OK. No obvious latency regressions on p95. Saw one 500 from model-gateway at 10:12 but it recovered.
elena: I ran the canary traffic generator for 10m. CPU on rtx-pool nodes hit ~72% at peak, memory flat. No OOMs. :thumbsup:
matt: QA ran the prompt conformance set. One failure case: system prompt truncation on long chat history. Investigating root cause now.
jeff: Patch I deployed was a small kv-cache boundary fix. Rolling back is 1-step if needed. Patch id: rwd-2394.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started — slice=traffic-slice-12 pct=5 image=runtime:v2.3.1
natalie: Matt — can you paste failing example? we need to know severity before ramp.
matt: Failing example: long user history + function call metadata causes truncation. Repro snippet:
```
user_history = "..." * 1200
call = {"tool":"price_lookup","args":{...}}
```
Response missing last function args occasionally.
elena: looks like kv-cache eviction earlier than expected when token count high. Jeff, does rwd-2394 touch cache pointers?
jeff: It nudges the cache window. Could explain boundary symptoms. I'll add extra guard and re-run QA.
qa-bot: qa-runner: conformance-suite v12 completed against canary — 1 failed test (chat-truncation) flagged.
matt: Blocker timeline: need small fix + redeploy; estimate ~25-30m including test run. If we hold at 5% we can patch in prod canary, then decide ramp.
natalie: Good. Ops: keep slice at 5%. No ramp until we get a green from QA and no new 500s for 15m.
ops-bot: acknowledged — holding canary at 5%.
jeff: I'll push hotfix rwd-2394b in ~10m and run quick smoke. Will post logs.
elena: I'll add an extra metric alert on kv-cache-eviction-rate so we can watch during ramp.
matt: After fix I'll re-run the long-history conformance cases. If green, recommend 20% next and observe 30m.
natalie: Sounds good. Please ping here when smoke + qa pass. If anything looks off, call pager. :eyes:
jeff: Smoke logs after deploy (preview):
```
[INFO] 10:45 smoke: p95=120ms p99=410ms 500s=0
[WARN] 10:46 cache: eviction_rate=0.03
```
jeff: QA run started against hotfix.
qa-bot: qa-runner: hotfix-run v12.1 completed — 0 failures on conformance-suite / long-history tests passed.
matt: Confirmed — fixed. No truncation repro now.
natalie: Great. Ops, coordinate ramp to 20% when you confirm no regressions in next 15m.
ops-bot: ramping to 20% over 5m now.
elena: Observability: cpu & eviction rate look stable. No new errors so far.
jeff: keeping an eye. tagging this thread with results.
natalie: Thanks team — will summarize in the release doc after final 30m observation. :thumbsup:
